commit.message:
fix(#2318): regenerate the PR Changes section from the diff after every session; one cost for free models

- The "### Changes" section is now solve-owned (between hive-mind:changes
  markers), lists the changed paths, and is regenerated from gh pr diff at
  the end of the first session and of every successful restart iteration,
  for every model. The issue reference and human text are kept; the
  unmarked sections solve wrote before (Kotlin's "1 file(s) modified",
  Rust's placeholder sentence) are recognised and replaced.
- A free model's comment printed $0.00 (Free model) and a list-price
  "$0.576812 cost" on the Total line. When the session's pricing is free,
  the budget stats omit the per-model cost, so the comment carries one figure.
- The quoted titles ('Implement Hello World in Kotlin') came from
  --title "${updatedTitle}" on 2026-07-30, fixed by 46b2df22; the current
  paths are pinned by the new test and experiments/pr-title-quoting-2318.mjs.
